preheader: Treasury yields hit multi-decade highs, bank earnings arrive, and Zheng makes history in Beijing.

lead.headline: Treasury yields hit multi-decade highs under hawkish Fed pressure
lead.body: Thirty-year Treasury yields have climbed to their highest levels since 2002 following a steep bond market selloff. In September alone, the 10-year yield rose more than half a percentage point to roughly 5.3%, marking the worst monthly drop for U.S. government debt in four years.
lead.why: Higher yields push up debt financing costs for startups and corporate buyouts, which directly impacts the valuation models you will study in your Merage finance classes.

figures.label: last time 30-year yields reached this level

stories.headline: Wall Street kicks off third-quarter earnings with major banks
stories.body: JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and Wells Fargo report third-quarter earnings on Tuesday. JPMorgan enters the week having generated the most revenue from IPO fees of any bank so far in 2026.
stories.why: League table performance shows which investment banks have deal momentum, helping you target your applications for sophomore summer analyst programs.

stories.headline: Starlink targets low pricing in India to rival Reliance Jio
stories.body: Elon Musk stated that Starlink will price its satellite broadband service affordably in India to compete with Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Jio. Both companies are awaiting regulatory security clearances as Jio prepares for an upcoming IPO.
stories.why: This rivalry gives you a live case study in pricing strategy and market entry when taking on a dominant domestic incumbent.

stories.headline: Apple prepares smart home hub alongside potential ADT partnership
stories.body: Apple has invited media to a New York event on Tuesday, where it is expected to introduce an all-new smart home hub. Industry clues suggest the company may also announce a collaboration with security provider ADT.
stories.why: Big tech firms often partner with legacy service companies to make their smart hardware platforms sticky for everyday consumers.

stories.headline: Users run local AI models on personal hardware over privacy concerns
stories.body: More users are turning to open models like Qwen directly on personal Mac and Windows machines using tools like Hermes Agent. The move is driven by a desire to avoid sending sensitive personal data to cloud providers.
stories.why: Learning how on-device AI runs will help you understand data privacy requirements when building startup applications.

stories.headline: McKinsey projects 11 million Americans must change fields due to AI
stories.body: A new McKinsey report indicates that the U.S. economy will have more total jobs by 2035 than today, but the occupational mix will shift significantly. Roughly 11 million workers will need to leave shrinking sectors and complete retraining or credential programs.
stories.why: Corporations will turn to management consultants to design large workforce transitions and restructuring plans over the next decade.

stories.headline: Operating model redesigns drive corporate AI payoffs
stories.body: McKinsey found that companies capture measurable value from AI only when they overhaul their broader operating models. Real advantages come from restructuring workflows and decision-making authority rather than simply buying new software licenses.
stories.why: This is core strategy consulting work. Understanding how companies reorganize work will give you strong talking points in case interviews.

stories.headline: Qinwen Zheng makes history with China Open title
stories.body: Olympic champion Qinwen Zheng defeated 2026 French Open champion Mirra Andreeva 7-5, 6-4 on Sunday in Beijing. The victory makes Zheng the first Chinese player to ever win the China Open.

term.name: Hawkish
term.definition: A hawkish stance describes central bank policymakers who prioritize fighting inflation by keeping interest rates high, even if that slows down economic expansion. When markets expect hawkish policy, bond prices fall and yields rise because investors require higher returns to commit their capital.

serve.headline: Persona raised $10M to build an AI personal assistant
serve.body: Nineteen-year-old founder Zach Yadegari raised $10 million for his new startup Persona after previously co-founding and selling calorie tracker Cal AI. The company is building an AI assistant focused on daily productivity and user retention.
